flagged.finding: Page (lm-feeds-and-speeds.md, live page datePublished 2021-04-19, dateModified 2025-11-18): "we usually recommended lower plunge rates (100mm/min to 300mm/min) for most materials", for 2-flute 1/8 in end mills. Chart (FeedsSpeedsMetric.pdf, created 2022-11-08): plunge about 0.50 x feed on flat/ball rows, e.g. "1/8\" Flat End Mill UC 1620 810" (Reduced). The chart is newer. Sienci names it as its guide: blog 2022-11-28 ("standardized testing method ... downloadable PDF guides") and the current page resources.sienci.com/view/cnc-feeds-speeds/ (dateModified 2026-05-13) links the same PDF (same sha256) and prints the same tables. Use the chart. New finding: that live web table differs from the PDF on 5 tapered-ball rows (030, 032, 033, 083, 085), where the web plunge is lower (fraction about 0.33 on the soft page). All other flat/ball/V/round-groove feed/plunge values are the same.

robgrz, post 1 of /t/50824, 2022-09-29T12:07Z. Discourse JSON: staff=true, admin=true, moderator=true (the forum shows the staff badge). Text: "We just posted an update to CC to include ramping in Pro ... If ramping is enabled, the feedrate is 1/3 of the feerate, or 100% of the plunge rate, whichever is higher." This is a description of Carbide Create Pro behaviour at that build, not advice. It can have changed in later builds ("we'd add a dedicated ramping rate field ... in the future").

Confirmed: "If the value is bigger than the diameter of the tool it can leave a boss standing in the center of the helix." Captions "Value of 1.8 x the Dia" and "Value of 0.8 x the Dia" sit in a table cell row under two animations. The value is the helix path diameter ("causes the tool to overlap it's center"), so "path radius <= 0.5 x D" is a fair and geometrically exact reading for a flat tool. 0.8 x D is an example, not a maximum or a default (g10-hobby-019 grade_wrong on the parameter mapping). Extra: the Ramping Angle figure prints "2°" (alt "ramping angle - 2 degrees"): an example value in the vendor help, which the dead-end table says the help does not print.

User post only (machinemoney, staff=false, 2024-03-27). No staff reply gives an angle. One search plus guides.carbide3d.com/create/toolpaths/ and carbide3d.com/hub/courses/create/toolpaths/: no ramp/helix text. No Carbide 3D document found.
One search found no OSG primary; only CNCCookbook repeats it. Keep grade c, second hand.

V-tip EM2E4: "Plunge rate = 40 IPM to 250 IPM (again depending on material being cut)". Micro EM2E8: "Plunge rate = 5 IPM to 25 IPM"; "plunge style tip geometry". Tapered ball 2F: "Plunge rate = depends on speed (RPM)", no number. None of the four pages has ramp, helix or a must-not-plunge rule (the only "helix" hits are menu text and the fret-plane flute helix angle).
